name: Privacy (VPN / Tor / Remote access)
note: Deliberately requests no capability: the panes read a local status API from the root-owned nuxel-privacy daemon over loopback. The app cannot change state without an explicit, audited action from that daemon.

landlock_rules.kernel_note: INTENT ONLY: Landlock requires Linux >= 5.13; the S10+ runs 4.14.253.

network_policy.kernel_note: Tor/VPN control happens in the daemon, not in the app. The app never gets egress.

enforcement.root_note: Tor/VPN/remote state is changed only by the root daemon; the app is a read-mostly viewer.
enforcement.apparmor: none yet (add a profile before claiming enforcement)
enforcement.note: Honesty requirement: 'Tor service running' is displayed separately from 'traffic verified through Tor'.
